name: GoldenEye 007 (PC port)
credits: jkdansereau and the GoldenEye 007 PC port contributors; KholdFuzion and the GoldenEye 007 decompilation contributors

builtin.name: Steady aim
builtin.description: With the Centred aim mode, standing still no longer sways the view with Bond's breathing: the view stays level and centred.

builtin.name: Quick weapon select
builtin.description: Hold next weapon to open a list of everything you carry (gadgets too); move with the stick or D-pad, release to equip. The game pauses while it's open. Works in the tank too. A tap still cycles.

builtin.name: Instant pause
builtin.description: The world stops the moment you press Start and starts again only when you have control back: no vulnerable frames while the watch comes up or goes away.

builtin.name: Complexity and difficulty
builtin.description: The difficulty screen asks twice: complexity (objectives, guards and objects; it unlocks missions as before), then enemy difficulty (accuracy, damage, health, ammo). Easier enemies than the complexity save no best time and earn no cheat.
